queued.title: 12 Characteristic Preludes, Op. 9 (in the form of melodic studies)
Graded Course of Violin Playing (8 books)

notes: Auer's catalogue is thin and poorly documented, so I made only one minor change. I filled in a minutes value for the Rêverie, Op. 3. Existing levels look sensibly ordered: the lyrical Rêverie sits below the two virtuoso showpieces. I could not verify the queued N1–N3 (the 12 Preludes, the Rêverie No. 2 and the Romance), so they are left untouched. The Rêverie No. 2 has no opus number to match against Op. 3, so I am not flagging it as a duplicate. The Graded Course (Carl Fischer, 8 books) is genuine.

fixes.reason: A single-movement lyrical salon rêverie typically lasts about 4 minutes; the field is currently unknown.
